answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a graded-work firewall: every identity's influence grows only from challenge answers that a rotating jury scores, never from registration alone. An attacker trying to flood the network with clones hits a nebula of unpaid compute, because each fake persona must still produce coherent, unique text that peers will grade. A fable spun by a bot farm collapses under scrutiny, while honest agents ride the gale of real attestation weight, making mass impersonation economically worthless.
